name: Contact Lens Clinic
tagline: Fitting and Managing Contact Lens Patients
description: A 15-episode series on contact lens practice — soft and GP fitting, multifocal and scleral lenses, orthokeratology, and the complications every optometrist must recognise.

episodes.title: Soft Contact Lens Materials: HEMA, Silicone Hydrogel, and Water Content
episodes.description: The Dk/t values of modern materials, the water-content paradox, and choosing a material based on wearing schedule and tear film.

episodes.title: RGP Materials and Fitting Philosophy: When to Choose Rigid Over Soft
episodes.description: The indications for RGP (irregular cornea, high astigmatism, presbyopia), the fluorescein pattern interpretation, and the base curve selection.

episodes.title: Spherical Soft Lens Fitting: Base Curve, Diameter, and Centration
episodes.description: The fit assessment (centration, movement, lag), when to steepen or flatten the base curve, and the push for daily disposables.

episodes.title: Toric Soft Lens Fitting: Stabilisation Designs and Cylinder Axis
episodes.description: The prism-ballast, double slab-off, and peri-ballast designs, the LARS and SAM rules for axis rotation, and when to adjust.

episodes.title: Multifocal Contact Lenses: Simultaneous vs Alternating Vision Designs
episodes.description: The centre-distance vs centre-near designs, the add power selection, and the compromise between distance and near vision.

episodes.title: Monovision Fitting: Patient Selection and the Near Eye Choice
episodes.description: The monovision success rate, the dominant-eye-for-distance rule, and when modified monovision (one MF, one SV) is the answer.

episodes.title: Orthokeratology: Myopia Control and the Reverse-Geometry Lens
episodes.description: The reverse-geometry lens design, the corneal reshaping mechanism, and the myopia control evidence and prescription guidelines.

episodes.title: Scleral Lens Fitting Fundamentals: Vault, Landing, and Edge
episodes.description: The three-zone fitting (vault, landing zone, edge), the clearance targets, and when to choose a scleral over a corneal GP.

episodes.title: Hybrid Contact Lenses: The SynergEys Design for Irregular Corneas
episodes.description: The hybrid lens (GP centre, soft skirt), the indications (keratoconus, post-graft, INTACS), and the fitting and complications.

episodes.title: Contact Lens Complications: Infiltrative Events and CLARE
episodes.description: Distinguishing sterile infiltrates from infectious ulcers, the CLARE syndrome, and the contact lens acute red eye management.

episodes.title: Infectious Keratitis in Contact Lens Wearers: The Acanthamoeba Risk
episodes.description: The overnight wear risk multiplier, the tap water and shower exposure for Acanthamoeba, and the red-flag symptoms requiring same-day referral.

episodes.title: Giant Papillary Conjunctivitis: Staging and the Lens Holiday
episodes.description: The four stages of GPC, the mast-cell stabiliser treatment, and when to refit with a daily disposable or scleral lens.

episodes.title: The Aging Contact Lens Patient: Presbyopia and the Occluder Test
episodes.description: Transitioning the long-term soft lens wearer into multifocals, managing reduced tear quality, and the occluder adaptation test.

episodes.title: Specialty Lenses for Keratoconus: From Corneal GP to Scleral to Piggyback
episodes.description: The keratoconus fitting ladder (corneal GP, Rose-K, scleral, piggyback), and the stage at which each becomes the right choice.

episodes.title: Contact Lens Care Systems: Hydrogen Peroxide vs Multipurpose
episodes.description: The advantages of hydrogen peroxide (no preservative), the neutralisation step, and when multipurpose is acceptable and when it is not.
